title: Settings
description: Manage your application preferences and account settings
languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the application
marketsDescription: Select markets to display. "Any" shows all relevant data.
currencyDescription: Stocks will display in their exchange currency (e.g., NOK for Norway, USD for US)
defaultHomepageDescription: Choose where you land when opening BullPen
homepageStockTickerHint: Opens that stock’s page when you start on Discover (e.g. NVDA).
roundNumbersDescription: Display whole numbers instead of decimals in holdings, portfolio values, and similar places
marketContextDescription: Default view for market hours, movers, and news on Discover
priceAlertsDescription: Get notified when stocks reach your target prices
breakingNewsDescription: Receive alerts for important market news
insiderTradesDescription: Notifications for significant insider trading activity
signalThresholdDescription: Alerts when signals cross your configured thresholds
logoutAllDescription: Sign out from all devices and sessions
exportDataDescription: Download all your data in a portable format
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone.
confirmDeleteFinal: This will permanently delete all your data. Type DELETE to confirm.
